name: sei-architecture-methodology
description: Automates the SEI (Carnegie Mellon Software Engineering Institute) architecture practice end to end: quality attribute scenarios, Quality Attribute Workshop (QAW), Attribute-Driven Design (ADD 3.0), Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method (ATAM), and Views-and-Beyond documentation. Includes a diagramming skill that renders clean, low-crossing UML / C4 diagrams to PNG with a curated palette.
